    red: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.red, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
    green: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.green, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
    blue: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.blue, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
}

/** One exact floating-point RGB value per output position. */

    row.map((red, columnIndex) => [
        red,
        photoBlurChannelFloats.green[rowIndex][columnIndex],
        photoBlurChannelFloats.blue[rowIndex][columnIndex],
    ]))

/** PixelGrid consumes bytes, so rounding happens only at this display boundary. */
export const photoBlurredPixels: RgbPixel[][] = photoBlurOutputFloats.map(row => row.map(pixel =>

    weight: kernelNumerators[rowIndex][columnIndex],

export interface PhotoBlurState {
    layout: number
    reveal: number
    tap: number
    rows: number
}

const integerLabels = (values: number[][]) => values.map(row => row.map(String))

function maskedOutputPixels(rowsVisible: number, theme: ThemeMode): RgbPixel[][] {
    const blank: RgbPixel = theme === 'dark' ? [22, 28, 38] : [224, 229, 236]
    return photoBlurredPixels.map((row, rowIndex) => row.map(pixel =>
        rowIndex < rowsVisible ? pixel : blank))
}

    const photoWidth = 520 - layout * 168

    const partialRedValue = partialRedSum / 16
    const visibleOutputRows = maskedOutputPixels(rowsVisible, theme)
    const activeInputCell = {
        row: selectedRow + Math.floor(tap / 3) - 1,

const kernelNumerators = [
    [1, 2, 1],
    [2, 4, 2],
    [1, 2, 1],
]

/** This is the fixed interior output shown by the source patch and kernel. */
export const photoBlurTarget = { row: 13, column: 14 } as const
export const photoBlurKernel = kernelNumerators.map(row => row.map(value => value / 16))

/** Display crop aligns one input pixel with each valid 30 × 30 output pixel. */
export const photoBlurSourceCrop: RgbPixel[][] = cifar10Pixels.slice(1, 31).map(row =>
    row.slice(1, 31).map(pixel => [pixel[0], pixel[1], pixel[2]] as const))

const sourcePlanes = {
    red: rgbChannel(cifar10Pixels, 'red'),
    green: rgbChannel(cifar10Pixels, 'green'),
    blue: rgbChannel(cifar10Pixels, 'blue'),
}

/** Keep the full precision output from cross-correlation for all calculations. */
export const photoBlurChannelFloats = {
    red: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.red, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
    green: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.green, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
    blue: crossCorrelate2d(sourcePlanes.blue, photoBlurKernel, { padding: 'valid' }),
}

/** One exact floating-point RGB value per output position. */
export const photoBlurOutputFloats: number[][][] = photoBlurChannelFloats.red.map((row, rowIndex) =>
    row.map((red, columnIndex) => [
        red,
        photoBlurChannelFloats.green[rowIndex][columnIndex],
        photoBlurChannelFloats.blue[rowIndex][columnIndex],
    ]))

/** PixelGrid consumes bytes, so rounding happens only at this display boundary. */
export const photoBlurredPixels: RgbPixel[][] = photoBlurOutputFloats.map(row => row.map(pixel =>
    [Math.round(pixel[0]), Math.round(pixel[1]), Math.round(pixel[2])] as const))

const selectedRow = photoBlurTarget.row
const selectedColumn = photoBlurTarget.column
export const photoBlurInputWindow = {
    row: selectedRow,
    column: selectedColumn,
    rows: 3,
    columns: 3,
}

/** Red values from the exact 3 × 3 source window used for output[13, 14]. */
export const photoBlurRedPatch = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, row) =>
    Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, column) => sourcePlanes.red[photoBlurInputWindow.row + row][photoBlurInputWindow.column + column]))

const photoBlurTargetFloats = photoBlurOutputFloats[selectedRow][selectedColumn]
const photoBlurTargetBytes = photoBlurredPixels[selectedRow][selectedColumn]
const redTerms = photoBlurRedPatch.flatMap((row, rowIndex) => row.map((value, columnIndex) => ({
    value,
    weight: kernelNumerators[rowIndex][columnIndex],
})))

export interface PhotoBlurState {
    layout: number
    reveal: number
    tap: number
    rows: number
}

const integerLabels = (values: number[][]) => values.map(row => row.map(String))

function maskedOutputPixels(rowsVisible: number, theme: ThemeMode): RgbPixel[][] {
    const blank: RgbPixel = theme === 'dark' ? [22, 28, 38] : [224, 229, 236]
    return photoBlurredPixels.map((row, rowIndex) => row.map(pixel =>
        rowIndex < rowsVisible ? pixel : blank))
}

/** Shared by the catalog still and video so every displayed value agrees. */
export function photoBlurFrame(theme: ThemeMode, state: Readonly<PhotoBlurState> = { layout: 1, reveal: 1, tap: 8, rows: 30 }) {
    const c = getThemeColors(theme)
    const layout = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.layout))
    const reveal = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.reveal))
    const tap = Math.max(0, Math.min(8, Math.floor(state.tap)))
    const rowsVisible = Math.max(0, Math.min(30, Math.floor(state.rows)))

    const imageSize = 330 - layout * 54
    const photoLeft = 380 - layout * 336
    const photoWidth = 520 - layout * 168
    const photoHeight = 420 - layout * 66
    const partialRedSum = redTerms.slice(0, tap + 1).reduce((sum, term) => sum + term.value * term.weight, 0)
    const partialRedValue = partialRedSum / 16
    const visibleOutputRows = maskedOutputPixels(rowsVisible, theme)
    const activeInputCell = {
        row: selectedRow + Math.floor(tap / 3) - 1,
        column: selectedColumn + tap % 3 - 1,
    }

                <PixelGrid c={c} pixels={photoBlurSourceCrop} width={imageSize} height={imageSize}
                    region={{ row: selectedRow - 1, column: selectedColumn - 1, rows: 3, columns: 3 }}
                    activeCell={activeInputCell} highlightColor={accent} />
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>Matching crop · output [13, 14]</span>
            </div>

                <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 730 }}>One window, one calculation</span>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>Output [13, 14] reads rows 13–15, columns 14–16.</span>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 15, marginTop: 9 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9 }}>
                        <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>RED INPUT</span>
                        <Matrix c={c} data={photoBlurRedPatch} labels={integerLabels(photoBlurRedPatch)} colorize={false} format="integer" fontSize={19} cellWidth={46} cellHeight={45}
                            highlightCell={{ row: Math.floor(tap / 3), col: tap % 3 }} highlightColor={accent} />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9 }}>
                        <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>KERNEL / 16</span>
                        <Matrix c={c} data={kernelNumerators} labels={integerLabels(kernelNumerators)} colorize={false} format="integer" fontSize={19} cellWidth={46} cellHeight={45}
                            highlightCell={{ row: Math.floor(tap / 3), col: tap % 3 }} highlightColor={accent} />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>Gaussian-like binomial · weights sum to 1.</span>
                <span style={{ color: theme === 'dark' ? c.infoLight : c.infoDark, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>same kernel on each color channel</span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 824, top: 154, display: 'flex', width: 412, height: 354, flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, padding: '12px 8px 8px', boxSizing: 'border-box', border: `1px solid ${c.borderSubtle}`, borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: c.bgCard, opacity: reveal }}>
                <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 730 }}>The blurred photo emerges</span>
                <PixelGrid c={c} pixels={visibleOutputRows} width={276} height={276}
                    activeCell={{ row: selectedRow, column: selectedColumn }} highlightColor={accent} />
                <span style={{ color: rowsVisible < 30 ? c.textSecondary : theme === 'dark' ? c.positiveLight : c.positiveDark, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {rowsVisible < 30 ? `COMPUTING · ${rowsVisible} / 30 rows` : '30 × 30 RGB · valid padding'}
                </span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 44, top: 524, display: 'flex', width: 1192, height: 155, flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '14px 20px', boxSizing: 'border-box', border: `1px solid ${c.borderSubtle}`, borderRadius: 14, backgroundColor: c.bgCard, opacity: reveal }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9 }}>
                    <span style={{ color: accent, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>OUTPUT [13, 14]</span>
                    <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>
                        {isCalculationComplete
                            ? `float RGB [${photoBlurTargetFloats.map(value => value.toFixed(4)).join(', ')}]  →  byte RGB [${photoBlurTargetBytes.join(', ')}] (rounded for display)`
                            : 'RGB result appears after all 9 weighted terms'}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>term {tap + 1} / 9</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>
                    <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary, fontWeight: 700 }}>RED {isCalculationComplete ? 'output' : `partial ${tap + 1}/9`}:</span>
                    <span>(</span>
                    {visibleRedTerms.map((term, index) => (
                        <span key={`red-term-${index}`} style={{ color: accent, fontWeight: index === visibleRedTerms.length - 1 ? 750 : 500 }}>
                            {term.value}×{term.weight}{index < visibleRedTerms.length - 1 ? ' + ' : ''}
                        </span>
                    ))}
                    <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary }}>) / 16 = {isCalculationComplete ? photoBlurTargetFloats[0].toFixed(4) : `${partialRedValue.toFixed(4)} so far`}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>
                    <span>CIFAR-10 training batch 1, record 0 · Krizhevsky (2009)</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

    return photoBlurFrame(theme)
